  declared name against a known Claude Code tool set (and rejects Tools on
  the cli runner, where it's meaningless), spawner.go passes it verbatim to
  claude's --tools flag (switched from the hardcoded --allowedTools, since
  --tools is the flag whose documented semantics -- "" disables every
  built-in tool -- exactly match "empty means none, not a default set"
  without depending on how --permission-mode auto treats an omitted
  --allowedTools). daemon.Spawner and daemontest.FakeSpawner both carry the
  new tools parameter so every implementation and test double stays in sync.

  client.FetchMessage synchronously -- before OnNewMail's deferred

  declares a "text" arg and reads the body from context instead.
  BuildContract's (mission.go) "read the email via beadle-email tools"
  success_criteria line is gone, per the contract.

  docs-ask) or have it validated-away (sysreport, cli runner) --
  documented in examples/recipes/README.md along with the least-privilege
  convention. Recipe prompts that told the worker to "submit ... as the
  mission result" were rewritten to describe what actually happens on the
  pipeline path (the final response text is captured directly) since that
  instruction needed tools those recipes no longer grant.

  6 commits, each green on make check. Did not push, per instructions.
